name: pt_announcement_search
description: Search PORTUGUESE public-procurement tender ANNOUNCEMENTS (contract notices) published through Portal BASE (base.gov.pt), run by IMPIC (Instituto dos Mercados Públicos, do Imobiliário e da Construção). IMPIC's own live API needs registration and a token Pipeworx does not hold yet, so this answers from a refreshed recent-window dataset (see data_as_of and the window fields in the response). Filter by free-text keyword (matched against the Portuguese notice title), CPV classification code or prefix (e.g. "45" for construction, "72000000" for IT services), contracting-authority (buyer) name substring (Portuguese spelling, e.g. "Câmara Municipal", "Instituto"), and a publish-date range. Returns compact shaped notices: id, IMPIC notice id, buyer, title, notice type, contract type(s), base amount (EUR), CPV, publish date, and proposal deadline. Call pt_announcement_detail with the returned id for the full record.

query.description: Keyword(s), case-insensitive, matched against the Portuguese notice title, e.g. "limpeza", "software", "obras", "manutenção".

cpv.description: CPV classification code or numeric prefix, e.g. "45" (construction works), "72000000" (IT services).

buyer.description: Contracting-authority (buyer) name, partial match, Portuguese spelling, e.g. "Câmara Municipal de Lisboa", "Instituto", "Universidade".

date_from.description: Earliest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days before date_to.

date_to.description: Latest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the newest date in the loaded window (see ann_window_to in any response), which can trail today because IMPIC publishes per-year bulk files.

limit.description: Max notices to return (default 20, max 100). Newest-first.

name: pt_announcement_detail
description: Fetch one PORTUGUESE tender announcement by the internal "id" returned from pt_announcement_search. Returns the full record: IMPIC notice id, buyer (with NIF tax number), notice type, contract type(s), procedure model, base amount, CPV codes, lot descriptions, publish date, proposal deadline and window, and a link to the official notice document.

id.description: The announcement's internal id, from pt_announcement_search.

name: pt_contract_search
description: Search PORTUGUESE public-procurement AWARDED CONTRACTS published through Portal BASE (base.gov.pt), run by IMPIC. Filter by free-text keyword (matched against the Portuguese contract title), buyer (adjudicante/contracting-authority) name substring, supplier (adjudicatário/awarded contractor) name substring, contract-amount range (EUR), and a publish-date range. Returns compact shaped contracts: contract id, title, buyer, supplier, amount (EUR), contract type(s), CPV, publish date, and the contract-signing date. Call pt_contract_detail with the returned idcontrato for the full record.

query.description: Keyword(s), case-insensitive, matched against the Portuguese contract title, e.g. "pavimentação", "formação", "software".

buyer.description: Contracting-authority (buyer/adjudicante) name, partial match, Portuguese spelling, e.g. "Câmara Municipal do Porto", "Ministério".

supplier.description: Awarded supplier (adjudicatário) name, partial match, e.g. "Mota-Engil", "Altice".

date_from.description: Earliest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days before date_to.

date_to.description: Latest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the newest date in the loaded window (see contract_window_to in any response).

limit.description: Max contracts to return (default 20, max 100). Newest-first.

name: pt_contract_detail
description: Fetch one PORTUGUESE awarded contract by its "idcontrato" (returned from pt_contract_search). Returns the full record: buyer and supplier (with NIF tax numbers), full title and description, amount, base procurement price, CPV codes, execution deadline, execution location(s), procedure type, publish/signing/decision dates, and the legal regime cited.

idcontrato.description: The contract's id, e.g. "12026866". Returned by pt_contract_search.
